'''2003 Minnesota State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship in Minnesota (21 June 2003). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS5]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Minnesota
* '''Dates:''' 21 June 2003<ref name="pc-us03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040622065452/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/usevents.htm State Championships (US Events)], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 22 June 2004.</ref>
* '''Time:''' 10:30am<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Fee:''' $5<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Venue:''' Twin City Comics, Columbia Heights, Minnesota<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Nick Kolnik]]<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Day 2 qualifier:''' [[Jim Li]]<ref name="pc-us03" />

The championship was the Saturday of the Minnesota State Championship Weekend (20–21 June 2003) at Twin City Comics in Columbia Heights: six games of Swiss and a final confrontation between the top two, with $100, $50 and $25 to the top three, the Day 2 bye to the winner<ref name="pc-mnweekend">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030822034604/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/mnstatesweekend04182003.htm The 2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 22 August 2003.</ref> and glass trophies for the top 4.<ref name="pcf-1291">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291&amp 2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik (10 April – 20 June 2003), Player's Committee Forums, swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 18 March 2004.</ref> The Friday sealed deck tournament drew 38 players.<ref name="pcf-1291" /> The championship was open to all players, not just residents of Minnesota, in accordance with the 2003 Championship Circuit format, and anyone who played in Friday's sealed deck tournament received free entry to Saturday's championship.<ref name="pc-mnweekend" /> Players who pre-registered for and attended either tournament were entered into a drawing for prizes including a four-card set of Ultra Rare foils from [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy|Reflections II]] and a set of Original Trilogy Special Edition Star Wars DVDs.<ref name="pc-mnweekend" /> Four of Twin City Comics' weekly Sunday tournaments leading up to the weekend (25 May and 1, 8 and 15 June 2003) were designated the Road to States, with cash bounties on certain individuals and additional prizes.<ref name="pc-mnweekend" /> [[Jim Li]] won the Day 2 bye.<ref name="pc-us03" />

Tournament director [[Nick Kolnik]] announced the weekend on the Players Committee forum on 10 April 2003, with a website (states.mnswccg.com) that took free pre-registrations, which could also be made in person at Twin City Comics.<ref name="pcf-1291-23802">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=23802#23802 2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (10 April 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Friday 20 June began with open play from noon, followed by a card tower building contest, a card throwing competition and Pack Wars, and then the sealed deck tournament from 6 PM ($5; four games; one Special Edition starter, two Jabba's Palace and two Premiere boosters). Saturday's championship registration ran from 9:30 AM, with complete decklists required, and the six-game constructed tournament included a 30-minute lunch break, with prize distribution and drawings at 5:30 PM and the two-game Final Confrontation after 6 PM.<ref name="pcf-1291-23802" /> Kolnik wrote on 14 April 2003 that the weekend would appear on the swccgpc.com homepage that week.<ref name="pcf-1309-23994">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=23994#23994 Desperately seeking Endor!], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (14 April 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041118162225/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=23970%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> The pre-registration drawing also included a set of LS and DS uncut sheets of [[Reflections]] foils; the four Reflections II Ultra Rare foils were Palpatine, Lord Vader, Jedi Luke and Mara. 20 players had pre-registered by 9 May,<ref name="pcf-1291-25380">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=25380#25380 2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (9 May 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> and 36 by 16 June 2003.<ref name="pcf-1291-29358">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=29358#29358 2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (16 June 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Kolnik wrote that all six Road to States events had double-digit attendance; [[Jim Li]] won the last one, on 15 June 2003, against 13 other players.<ref name="pcf-1291-29358" />
